recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中顆粒球前驅細胞大量停在前骨髓細胞階段（大細胞、核偏位、核周淡染、細胞質有顆粒），幾乎不見分葉中性球，並有明顯嗜酸性前驅細胞與單核球，為 Kostmann 症候群典型的前骨髓細胞成熟停滯。
features: Many large promyelocytes with eccentric nuclei, perinuclear hof, basophilic cytoplasm, and azurophilic granules
Near absence of metamyelocytes, bands, and segmented neutrophils
Eosinophilic precursors with orange-red granules are conspicuous
Erythroid precursors present with small dark round nuclei
Blasts are not increased; no Auer rods
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular with prominent promyelocytes showing eccentric nuclei, perinuclear hofs, basophilic cytoplasm, and azurophilic granules, with a striking lack of later-stage neutrophils including metamyelocytes, bands, and segmented forms. Eosinophilic precursors and monocytes are conspicuous, and erythroid precursors are present. Blasts are not increased and Auer rods are absent. Findings show granulocytic maturation arrest at the promyelocyte stage and, in a child with severe chronic neutropenia, are consistent with severe congenital neutropenia (Kostmann syndrome).

ddx.vs: APL replaces the marrow with atypical hypergranular promyelocytes with reniform or bilobed nuclei and faggot cells, carries PML::RARA, and lacks preserved erythroid and eosinophilic elements.

ddx.dx: Early marrow regeneration after neutropenic insult
ddx.vs: Regenerating marrow shows a synchronized promyelocyte wave that proceeds to full neutrophil maturation within days.
Cyclic neutropenia shows arrest only during the nadir with normal maturation between cycles every ~21 days, whereas SCN arrest is persistent.
Myelokathexis shows abundant hypersegmented, pyknotic mature neutrophils retained in the marrow rather than promyelocyte arrest.
